audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Cassiopeia level 1 and give Gangplank levels 3 and 4-5; the packet chart and the prose say the opposite on all three rows.
audit.why: whys[0] and the early section both say level 1 is yours — she has only Noxious Blast and cannot punish the step-up. whys[2] and whys[3] say the Miasma ground plus the Twin Fang refund out-DPS you and that she wins every extended trade in that window, and the mid section says levels 3 through 6 belong to her. Packet agrees with the prose on every row.
audit.corrected: Level 1 = Gangplank, Level 3 and Levels 4-5 = Cassiopeia. One atomic group across both layers with ratings moved.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes reads 'Cassiopeia: Miasma online, level 6, first item' and phases[4].why never names Petrifying Gaze.
audit.why: The real shape is: level 1 yours, levels 3-6 hers as Miasma (24s at rank 1) and the Twin Fang refund chain come online, Petrifying Gaze at 6 on 120s, then your Sheen window where an empowered Parrrley detonating a chain bursts a champion who builds no resistances — and then she reclaims it past three items.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names Petrifying Gaze, its 120s cooldown and its facing requirement.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names only Miasma and repeats one grounding sentence in four places. Twin Fang, Noxious Blast and Petrifying Gaze never appear, and nothing states the facing rule on her ultimate.
audit.why: Twin Fang is a 0.75s cooldown that deals more to poisoned targets and heals her for a share of the damage — that heal is what beats a chip-trade pattern and is why Grievous Wounds matters here. Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her and slows those with their back turned, so turning away downgrades the stun to a slow. Miasma at 24s at rank 1 is the countable window, not an always-on state.
audit.corrected: Twin Fang heal and anti-heal in dosFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns; the facing rule in report[5].t; Miasma's real cooldown in dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t lists no anti-heal for a matchup whose enemy heals off every Twin Fang cast.
audit.why: Twin Fang heals her for a percentage of damage dealt, on a 0.75s cooldown, against poisoned targets — the highest-uptime healing you face in this slice.
audit.corrected: Called for anti-heal in dosFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns; the itemization string itself is a shared template and is flagged rather than rewritten.

edits.after: Cash in level 1, survive the Twin Fang ramp, and burst her at your Sheen spike — she out-scales you after three items.
